name: stacked-notification-center
title: Stacked Notification Center
description: Chronological notification feed with filter tabs and mark-all-read action header.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Notification Inbox Scroll: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
